prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1320; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name and confirm that you're comfortable continuing.

A: Sure. I'm comfortable. My head's still a little foggy, so if I pause or repeat myself, bear with me.

Q: That's completely fine. Can you walk me through what you remember about the collision?

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light, heading straight. A pickup coming from my right didn't stop at the signal and hit the driver's side of my car. The impact spun me a bit and I hit my head on the window frame.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced to my right just as it came into view, and there wasn't time to do anything.

Q: Did you lose consciousness, even briefly?

A: I don't think so, but I was dazed for a few minutes. People were talking to me and I had trouble answering right away.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed a concussion and told me to limit screen time and rest. I still get headaches and I'm sensitive to bright light.

Q: Are you currently following the treatment plan you were given?

A: Mostly. I've had a hard time staying focused at work, so I've been taking shorter days and I'm seeing a specialist next week.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your account of the collision?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and the other driver admitted at the scene that they ran the light. That's about it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
